_what: Scenarios whose MEASURED turn (follow_ups[-1], else prompt) cannot reach their own tool through answerable_tools. Shrink-only. Almost every one is a DECLARATION gap: the sentence asks for what the tool does and the tool has not declared those words.
_three_categories_2026_08_30: This file used to be ONE flat list and it conflated three things that need OPPOSITE rules. Five of its 25 entries were already 'Yes, go ahead and do it.' confirmation turns — unreachable BY DESIGN, sitting in a shrink-only debt list they can never leave. Splitting them out was forced by two new scenarios of the same shape; it was not caused by them.
_scenarios_rule: DECLARATION DEBT. The sentence asks for what the tool does and the tool has not declared those words. SHRINK-ONLY: a new entry is a defect to fix (widen the tool's synonyms) or a decision to record, never a row to append. Becoming reachable is PROGRESS and the entry must be removed.

_by_design_rule: 🔴 THE INVERSE RULE. These measured turns cannot name their tool and MUST NOT be able to — a confirmation turn that carried tool vocabulary would be the bug. So becoming reachable here is a REGRESSION to shout about, not progress to celebrate, and the shrink-only staleness check that governs `scenarios` would have demanded exactly the wrong thing.

scenarios-c-authorsource.json::extract-c.reason: 🔴 A MEASURED FALSE POSITIVE OF THE GATE ITSELF. The gate predicts 'the tool will surface 0/N before a run is spent'. This scenario was run and glossary_extract_entities_from_doc was called on 5 of 5. R1 answerability is not the only surfacing path — the domain hot set advertises schemas the R1 phrase-match never forced — so an R1 miss does not imply the tool is unreachable.

_override_rule: An override is only admissible with a raw batch on disk showing the tool ACTUALLY CALLED. The test re-reads that file and re-counts; an override whose evidence stops supporting it fails. Without that, this section is just the escape hatch that lets any inconvenient flag be waved away — which is what the shrink-only rule exists to prevent.
_measured_precision_2026_08_30: Of the five flags raised on 2026-08-30, four are confirmed by a live 0/5 and one is refuted by a live 5/5 — precision 4/5 on this sample. The gate is useful and it is not authoritative.
